title: Web Automation Chains
summary: This module provides tools for AI agents to automate web browser interactions. It includes an LLM-driven chain for generating browser commands and a crawler for executing them and extracting page content.

nodes.label: User Automation Objective
nodes.title: User Objective
nodes.description: The high-level goal or task the user wants the AI to accomplish on the web.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Web Automation
nodes.title: NatBotChain
nodes.description: An LLM-driven chain that interprets user objectives and current browser state to decide the next action. It generates specific browser commands.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: LLM
nodes.description: The underlying language model providing the intelligence for NatBotChain to understand objectives and generate appropriate browser actions.

nodes.label: Current Browser Content
nodes.title: Browser Content
nodes.description: The visible content and structure of the web page currently displayed in the browser, used for analysis.

nodes.label: Generated Browser Commands
nodes.title: Browser Commands
nodes.description: Specific instructions (e.g., click, type, scroll) generated by NatBotChain for the crawler to execute.

nodes.label: Interact with Web Browser
nodes.title: Crawler
nodes.description: A web crawler utilizing Playwright to perform actions like navigation, scrolling, clicking, and typing, and to extract page elements.

nodes.label: External Web Browser
nodes.title: Web Browser
nodes.description: The actual web browser (e.g., Chromium via Playwright) that is being controlled and automated by the system.

groups.label: Automation Logic
groups.title: Automation Logic
groups.description: The core intelligence responsible for understanding user intent and planning web interactions.

groups.label: Generative Intelligence
groups.title: Generative Intelligence
groups.description: The large language model that powers the decision-making process for web automation.

groups.label: Web Interaction Engine
groups.title: Web Interaction Engine
groups.description: Handles the direct interaction with the web browser, executing commands and extracting information.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Data Flow
groups.description: Represents the inputs and outputs that drive and result from the web automation process.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Systems
groups.description: Components outside the direct control of the module, such as the actual web browser.
